snapshot.title: Engine Enhancements: Markers, Data Extraction, Ordering, Post-Parse Validation
snapshot.description: Implement 4 engine capabilities: (1) marker conversion for new `{{target_word}}` → `underlinedParts`, verify existing `{{phoneme}}`/`{{error}}` conversions, (2) `[WORD BANK:]` → `wordBank` + `blankMapping` and `(N điểm)` → point allocation, (3) section ordering by Vietnamese curriculum order, (4) post-parse validation (question count, numbering gaps, answer coverage, type-specific checks). Changes in `thcsDocumentParser.service.ts` and `thcs-draft-converter.ts`.
